text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding out what could go wrong in a project or situation. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are actions you will take if a risk actually occurs. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By checking regularly, you can spot new dangers and adjust your plans. Good risk management helps you stay calm and protect your goals.
